memberships.page_title: Resolvent Restrictions on a Cubic Normalization Defect

statement: In the stated one-parameter smooth cubic-axis hypersurface model, when the transverse three-torsion class extends as a section of the relative three-torsion group scheme, its rank-one reflexive module is maximal Cohen-Macaulay and the associated cubic normalization is flat.
title: The Smooth Cubic-Axis Resolvent Model Is Flat
